title: 10,000 Small Businesses in Southern California: Goldman Sachs
description: In October 2014, Los Angeles Mayor Eric Garcetti, Long Beach Mayor Robert Garcia and Goldman Sachs President and Chief Operating Officer Gary Cohn announced an additional $5 million for the Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses program in Southern California, an initiative which aims to help create jobs and economic growth by providing small business owners with practical business education, business support services and access to capital.

asr.full_text: You want ketchup for your fries and your fish? Well, let me get you one. One thing about this business that I really love is the generations of families that we fed over the years. We started this business when I was in the 10th grade. I was 15. After I lost my dad in 2001, I just committed my life to it. You know as a small business owner, I kind of feel like you're on an island all by yourself. And so when I saw the opportunity to participate with this 10,000 small businesses, I was like, oh my God. Good evening, my name is Georgette Powell I'm here from Mel's Fish. After our orientation I was in tears because I finally felt like I was in the room with people who knew what they were doing and were serious about it. If you look at those participants that went through the Goldman Sachs 10,000 small businesses program they've increased jobs they've also seen a lot of their profits increase at a higher rate than the national and regional economy as well. I've seen personally the lives exchanged. It's had a huge impact on the city of Long Beach. Our guiding principle in this country is equality of opportunity. 10,000 small businesses is a big part of that. UCAN Zippers started in 1989. 10,000 small businesses is a big part of that. You can zippers. Started in 1989. You name it, you know, handbags, home furnishings, we've done zippers for everybody and anybody. It's a family business. The last five years, I've been managing the day-to-day operations. Right around when I was doing the Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Business Program, that was when the transition period was happening. I was going through the program, my father saw the things that I was doing the Goldman Sachs 10,000 small business program. That was when the transition period was happening. I was going through the program. My father saw the things that I was doing and the things I was learning. He felt comfortable to relieve some of those duties that he was doing. To me, I used to think becoming a leader, you just had to go out there and be in the trenches with everybody. I learned from the program that I was able to create the vision and then have our employees execute the vision. Understanding that I can now put out some creative ideas, manage a production flow, and manage a team. He was happy because now he can kinda sit back and relax a little bit and enjoy the fruits of his labor. One thing about the Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Business Program is that it really works. The growth that I initially projected while in the program was about a 5% year-over- year for the next five years. After the program we closed out and we had 25% growth. Our business has been blooming. The Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses program has had tremendous impact. It's really our small businesses where we're seeing the most economic growth, the most job growth, and the most dynamism in our economy. The Goldman Sachs ten thousand small businesses program is aimed at men and women that want to grow their business, want to get smarter, want to hire more people, want to provide more goods, more services, for the community they Thanks for watching!

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it profiles a small-business support program offering education, services, and access to capital. Participants discuss their business experiences, leadership learning, and reported growth, while workplace visuals support that theme. Access to capital is described as part of the program, not as a request for viewers to transfer money or provide credentials; the program’s claims and outcomes remain unverified.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary subject is business education, leadership learning, and operational support for small businesses, rather than a scam mechanism or a financial-return solicitation.

evidence.observation: The described program provides practical business education, business support services, and access to capital for small business owners.
evidence.quote: an initiative which aims to help create jobs and economic growth by providing small business owners with practical business education, business support services and access to capital.

evidence.observation: A participant describes attending an orientation and receiving support from people she regarded as knowledgeable and serious.
evidence.quote: After our orientation I was in tears because I finally felt like I was in the room with people who knew what they were doing and were serious about it.

evidence.observation: The speaker reports that participants increased jobs and that many reported profit increases.
evidence.quote: If you look at those participants that went through the Goldman Sachs 10,000 small businesses program they've increased jobs they've also seen a lot of their profits increase at a higher rate than the national and regional economy as well.

evidence.observation: A participant attributes learning about setting a vision and managing employees to the program.
evidence.quote: I learned from the program that I was able to create the vision and then have our employees execute the vision.

evidence.observation: A participant reports 25% growth after completing the program.
evidence.quote: After the program we closed out and we had 25% growth.

evidence.observation: The program is described as serving people who want to grow businesses, improve knowledge, hire workers, and provide goods and services.
